title: Learning to Bid with Unknown Private Values in Budget-Constrained First-Price Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2605.09448v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the operational problem of automated bidding in repeated first-price auctions under budget and return-on-spend (RoS) constraints. In this setting, an auto-bidder must translate advertiser goals and constraints into real-time bids while learning two latent objects: the causal uplift value of each ad impression and the highest competing bid (HoB) needed to win it. We model uplift values and HoBs through a shared-context Linear Treatment Effect (LTE) structure and analyze both full-information and binary HoB feedback. We develop Dual-LTE, a dual-aware online learning framework that coordinates value estimation, HoB estimation, and budget/RoS control through confidence-guided exploration. translated_title: 在预算受限的一价拍卖中学习未知私有价值的出价策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09448v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究了在预算和广告支出回报率（RoS）约束下，重复一价拍卖中自动出价的操作性问题。在此设定下，自动出价者必须将广告主的目标和约束转化为实时出价，同时学习两个潜在对象：每次广告展示的因果提升价值以及赢得该展示所需的最高竞争出价（HoB）。我们通过共享上下文的线性处理效应（LTE）结构对提升价值和最高竞争出价进行建模，并分析了完全信息和二元HoB反馈两种情况。我们开发了Dual-LTE，一种双感知在线学习框架，通过置信度引导的探索来协调价值估计、HoB估计以及预算/RoS控制。我们证明了在完全信息HoB反馈下，遗憾和约束违反保证以$\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$的速率增长，在二元胜负反馈下以$\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$的速率增长，其中$\widetilde{O}(\cdot)$隐藏了依赖于问题的项。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Dual-LTE的在线学习框架，在预算和RoS约束下协调价值估计、竞争出价估计与预算控制，实现了对未知私有价值的一价拍卖自动出价，并提供了次线性的遗憾和约束违反保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual-aware online learning framework called Dual-LTE that coordinates value estimation, competing bid estimation, and budget/RoS control for automated bidding in repeated first-price auctions with unknown private values, achieving sublinear regret and constraint violation guarantees.
